definitions.explanation: Literary first-person pronoun referring to oneself, mainly preserved in proverbs, classical writing, and a small set of formal expressions about self-reflection.

examples.japanese: {己|おのれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{勝|か}つ→打ち勝つ：12768_uchikatsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to overcome oneself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}り→知る：00458_shiru⟧{己|おのれ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}れば→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦{百戦|ひゃくせん}→百戦：28342_hyakusen⟧⟦{危|あや}うから→危うい：11825_ayaui⟧ず。
examples.english: Know your enemy and know yourself, and you need not fear a hundred battles.

notes:
Literary and old-fashioned word for 'self'. Modern Japanese uses ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ in nearly all everyday contexts; {己|おのれ} survives in proverbs, classical-style writing, and a few set phrases about self-mastery.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {己|おのれ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to know oneself
- {己|おのれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ / ⟦{打|う}ち{勝|か}つ→打ち勝つ：12768_uchikatsu⟧: to overcome oneself
- {己|おのれ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{律|りっ}する: to discipline oneself
- {己|おのれ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to set aside the self

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧: oneself — the everyday word; use this in normal speech
- ⟦{我|われ}→我：30648_ware⟧: I; self — literary, formal speeches and writing
- ⟦{自我|じが}→自我：16132_jiga⟧: ego; the self — psychological/philosophical term
